concerns.text: FR-005, FR-006, and SC-001 specify a binary classification problem (Fragile vs. Robust), but tasks T023, T024, and T025 mandate a 'Multinomial (3-class)' approach. There is no task covering the binary classification model required by the spec, leaving FR-005/FR-006 unimplemented.

FR-007 requires a standard permutation test (n=100) to verify significance. Task T031 implements a 'stratified permutation test' (which is the requirement for FR-012). There is no dedicated task for the standard permutation test required by FR-007, leaving this success criterion unmet.

FR-011 specifies a Levenshtein ratio threshold of >= 0.85. The Plan.md constraints section revises this to >= 0.95. Task T015 implements the >= 0.85 threshold. There is no task to reconcile this contradiction or implement the plan's stricter threshold, creating a gap between the plan's constraints and the implemented logic.

T008 (Create data-model.md) and T009 (Create contracts/) are marked as incomplete (unchecked) in Phase 2, yet T017b (Validate contracts) and T039 (Review data-model) depend on them. The tasks for creating these foundational artifacts are missing completion status or implementation details, blocking downstream validation tasks.

Task T016b references 'T016 completion' as a dependency, but T016 is a single task containing two distinct logic blocks (label mapping and binary conversion). The task description conflates the creation of the logic with the writing of specific test cases inside the same task, making the dependency chain ambiguous for the binary conversion logic.
